records.description_rewritten: 'Rest area hamlet' is an awkward English translation of Rastplatz Weiler, the A57 motorway service/parking area near Köln-Roggendorf/Thenhoven. The Planet Randy page has nine dated visitor entries, all from 2021–2022, with some personal accounts of encounters. It matches the earlier Weiler/A57 record at queue #705, where other references distinguish Weiler and Esch on opposite A57 carriageways. None of Planet Randy's dated reviews establishes 2026 activity.

supplemental_sources.note: Primary Planet Randy detail with nine 2021–2022 reader posts.
Second directory links A57 Weiler and directionally distinct Esch; source has 2026 vegetation changes.

Historic encounter/attendance accounts, not present-day evidence.

records.description_rewritten: Agrippabad is Cologne's city-centre municipal swimming pool, sauna and fitness complex at Kämmergasse 1. It was closed for building works early in 2026 but the official operator announced complete public reopening on 17 July 2026, confirmed by a contemporary local report on that date. Some secondary directory pages still display stale closure text. The historical gay-szene cruising mention is not proof of active cruising in public pool showers/sauna or of men-only admission.

supplemental_sources.note: Official operator announcement of July 17 reopening after renovation.
17 July 2026 local confirmation the pool reopened.
Current operator facility page, verify schedule per date.

dated_recent_site_signals.note: Physical pool/sauna reopening, NOT cruising activity.

records.access_information: Paid supervised municipal bath/sauna with family, public and club users. Toilets, showers and changing rooms follow operator rules and consent; not a dedicated cruising establishment.
duplicates_and_review_flags: Official operator reopened July 17, 2026; stale guide pages saying closed must not override it.

records.description_rewritten: A historic 'Klappe' public toilet is described by a gay-szene.net entry at Kirchderner Straße 37 near Dortmund's Hoeschpark. The entry advertises 08:00–18:00 and internal fixtures, but none is official contemporary operational confirmation. A post dated 16 March 2026 seeks partners and praises the location but does not actually document an encounter; 2024–2025 comments are mixed, with several visitors reporting nobody there. Dortmund's October 2026 open public-toilet dataset is available for future exact record verification, and its Hoeschpark page separately confirms heritage toilet buildings in the park, but neither was matched specifically to this claimed 'Klappe' at present.
